La Banque des Entreprises

Step 3: Controlling Persons

Among the regulatory requirements regarding anti-money laundering and tax provisions La Banque des Entreprises is required to obtain and hold adequate, accurate and current information on the beneficial ownership of our clients, including the details of the beneficial interests held.

Please, read carefully the instructions in the Annex to understand the term “Controlling Person”.

1   Name and Surname:
    Type of control (1):                  Ownership % (2):
    Date of birth:                       Nationality:
    Country of residence:                Passport or national ID card number:
    Address of residence:

2   Name and Surname:
    Type of control (1):                  Ownership % (2):
    Date of birth:                       Nationality:
    Country of residence:                Passport or national ID card number:
    Address of residence:

3   Name and Surname:
    Type of control (1):                  Ownership % (2):
    Date of birth:                       Nationality:
    Country of residence:                Passport or national ID card number:
    Address of residence:
    Date on which the person became “Controlling Person”:

(1) Type of control:
A. It is a natural person who owns (directly or indirectly) more than 25% of the shares in the company or more than 25% of the voting rights in the company.
B. It is a natural person who exercises, by other means, control over the company. This includes individuals who hold the right to appoint or remove the majority of the board of directors of the company or have the right to exercise, or actually exercise, significant influence or control over the company.
C. In the absence of identification of a natural person(s) according to the two preceding criteria, the legal representative(s) of the company
(2) In case you select Type of control A. Please specify the Ownership (%)

Step 4: Certification

The requirements of the relevant anti money laundering legislation require institutions to gather client's information of their professional or business activity. The client subscribes to this Declaration and assumes the responsibility of the provided data listed on this declaration. Additionally, the client commits itself to communicate La Banque des Entreprises (La Banque des Entreprises) any data amendment during its relationship with La Banque des Entreprises. The lack of veracity or updates in the mentioned data and/or documents authorizes La Banque des Entreprises to terminate any or all the contracts formalized with the client.

Without prejudice to the provisions of article L.511-33 of the French Code monétaire et financier, and in accordance with them, the client expressly agrees that in addition to the cases provided for in this article, we may disclose to any entities belonging to the same group as La Banque des Entreprises, information about it protected by professional secrecy, if the persons to whom this information is disclosed are informed that it must be kept confidential to the extent legally permitted, or are legally or professionally bound by professional secrecy, and if this information is necessary for them for the following purposes and in the following cases: business development, development and management of the services and products offered, business relationships management with the client and with companies belonging to the same group if any, revenues and financial and operational risks management, fulfillment of their obligations or for auditing purposes or with respect to regulatory or supervisory authorities, and fraud prevention.

Communications made on this basis and treatment by their recipient of such disclosed information must comply with applicable personal data protection regulation.
